## Case isolation gate

- [ ] Any root README maintenance needed by this work is deferred to a separate PR.

## Evidence boundary

- [ ] Observed / primary / inference / speculation / failed states remain distinguishable where relevant.
- [ ] Resemblance or recurrence is not being promoted into ancestry without an attributable transmission road.
- [ ] Cross-case synthesis does not upgrade the evidence status of source cases by aggregation.
